# Volume 2 timeline

## I An Irate Neighbor

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) is day-dreaming while studying when Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) angrily confronts her about her cow escaping into his oat field again. After he leaves in a huff, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) locks the cow away and later discusses the incident and local gossip with [Aunt Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and Mrs. Agatha Sowerby over tea.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P28](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0028), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038)_

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — Mrs. Sowerby visits [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), gossiping about recent incidents and the influx of newcomers to the area. She questions [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about her proposed Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) and cautions her against pursuing it, while also mentioning that Nell's acquaintance, [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), will be teaching at [Delford](../codex/places.md#delford).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P50](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0050), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057)_

## II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Peter Mott](../character/peter-mott.md), [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), [Shearer](../character/shearer.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — On their way back from shopping in [Delford](../codex/places.md#delford), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde chase a Jersey cow out of a neighbor's oat field, and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) impulsively sells the cow to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md). Upon returning home to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) discovers her own cow is still in the pen, realizing she mistakenly sold Mr. Pettifer's cow instead. Resigned to face his temper, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) packs a freshly baked nut cake as a peace offering and sets off to confess her mistake to Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md).

_Sources: [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P24](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0024), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P35](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0035), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P41](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0041), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P42](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0042)_

## III Mr. Pettifer at Home

**[Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md), [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) visits Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) to confess that she mistakenly sold his Jersey cow instead of her own, offering him compensation or her cow in trade. To her relief, Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) reacts generously, accepts her cow in exchange, and invites her to stay for tea. After sharing a pleasant evening and discussing the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home and tells [Aunt Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) how well the ordeal turned out.

_Sources: [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P20](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0020), [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P35](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0035), [v2 III Mr. Pettifer at Home P53](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0053)_

## IV Different Opinions

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), [Pidgeon](../character/pidgeon.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Thorne](../character/thorne.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md), and Hugh discuss their differing views on classroom discipline before beginning their upcoming teaching terms. Afterward, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walks home to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), avoiding Mrs. Sowerby to instead converse with Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) about her plan to rule her school with affection. The next morning, a nervous [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) shares her anxieties over breakfast with [Aunt Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md).

_Sources: [v2 IV Different Opinions P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 IV Different Opinions P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007), [v2 IV Different Opinions P27](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0027), [v2 IV Different Opinions P41](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0041)_

## V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am

**[Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md), [Anthony Tulk](../character/anthony-tulk.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), Cottons, [Prillie Rogerson](../character/prillie-rogerson.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), Aspen Path, [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) begins her first day teaching school in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), observing the various pupils in her classroom and forming an immediate warm connection with [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md). After dealing with minor disciplinary issues and feeling exhausted by the day's end, she is visited by an overly eccentric mother, Mrs. Trask, who insists on specific pronunciations and names for her children. Afterwards, [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) gifts [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) wild orchids on her walk home, lifting her spirits before she reflects on the day with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md).

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P11](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0011), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P20](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0020)_

## VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

**[Catherine Pullen](../character/catherine-pullen.md), [Eben Duckett](../character/eben-duckett.md), [Eliza Pullen](../character/eliza-pullen.md), [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde begin canvassing for the [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), first visiting the Andrew sisters. While [Eliza](../character/eliza-pullen.md) bitterly refuses to donate, Catherine sneaks out to give them two quarters for the hall fund before they visit Daniel Blair.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P16](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0016), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P31](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0031)_

**[Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md), [Gideon Duckett](../character/gideon-duckett.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Tibby Tulk](../character/tibby-tulk.md), [Eliza Pullen](../character/eliza-pullen.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) recounts her and Isolde's day of soliciting donations throughout [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) to [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), describing helpful and unhelpful encounters alike. She takes advantage of Lorenzo White's excitement over his new baby boy to secure a large donation. Finally, she attempts to get a contribution from Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), who turns her down.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P34](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0034), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P44](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0044), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P49](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0049), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056)_

## VII The Pointing of Duty

**[Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh discuss their experiences teaching and their future ambitions before Hugh departs to run an errand. Afterwards, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) returns from visiting [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md), expressing concern over Mary's failing health and the uncertain future of the Farrow twins. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) successfully convinces [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to take in the children for the winter out of a sense of duty, offering to handle their sewing.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P4](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0004), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P12](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0012), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P23](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0023), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032)_

## VIII Thirza Adopts Twins

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), [Eliza Pullen](../character/eliza-pullen.md), [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md), [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Thomas Sowerby](../character/thomas-sowerby.md), [Wace](../character/wace.md)** — [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) brings the newly orphaned twins, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), back to live at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) proves to be extremely energetic and prone to mischief, including dropping a caterpillar down Lauretta's dress during church. During a meeting of the [Aid Society](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) at the house, a dripping-wet [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) bursts into the dining room after [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) entices her outside.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P47](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0047)_

**[Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), Aid Society, [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md)** — During an [Aid Society](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) meeting at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) tricks [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) into jumping into a pigpen and getting drenched under the water pump. After [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) is sent to his room, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) talks with him, prompting [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) to confess that he also hid a toad under Thirza's pillow, which [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) secretly removes.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P50](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0050), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060)_

## IX A Question of Color

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Gideon Duckett](../character/gideon-duckett.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Joshua Tulk](../character/joshua-tulk.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Oliver Mott](../character/oliver-mott.md), [Peter Mott](../character/peter-mott.md), [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Roger Tulk](../character/roger-tulk.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) debate Mrs. Sowerby's character and discuss the Improvement Society's progress on fixing up the hall. Later, Mrs. Sowerby and the youths discover that [Joshua Tulk](../character/joshua-tulk.md) painted the hall bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with paint order numbers. Despite the catastrophic outcome, the community rallies behind the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) and blames the [Tulks](../codex/factions.md#tulks) for the mistake.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040)_

## X Robin in Search of a Sensation

**[Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walks home through the woods, chatting with [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md) along the way. Upon arriving at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), she learns from [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) that young [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) has gone missing, sparking a desperate search that eventually leads to finding [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) locked in Mr. Pettifer's toolhouse by [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md). When confronted about his trickery and lying, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) breaks down in tears, admitting he didn't realize lying was wrong, leading [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to forgive the lies while determining how to discipline him for locking [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) away.

_Sources: [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P53](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0053), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P61](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0061)_

**[Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Wace](../character/wace.md), [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md)** — [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) discuss Robin's habit of lying and punish him by sending him to bed without dinner. Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) visits [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) in his room, where he tries to argue that [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) lied about the consequences of skipping prayers. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) defends [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), and after going downstairs, she and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) discuss Robin's mischievous behavior and how best to raise him.

_Sources: [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P61](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0061), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P63](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0063), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P70](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0070), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085)_

## XI Facts and Fancies

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Anthony Tulk](../character/anthony-tulk.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), Brierley, [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), [Clair](../character/clair.md), Delford, [Dinah Wren](../character/dinah-wren.md), [Eliza Pullen](../character/eliza-pullen.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Mabel Colby](../character/mabel-colby.md), Montreal, [Ned Clay](../character/ned-clay.md), [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), Stonebridge, [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), Yankee** — In a letter to [Mabel](../character/mabel-colby.md), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) recounts amusing experiences and humorous remarks from her students while teaching school in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley). She shares duplicates of student compositions, including an unexpectedly romantic letter from [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md) that was copied from old love letters, before introducing a letter from her favorite student, [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md).

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_

**[Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md), [Nora](../character/nora.md), [Twin Sailor](../character/twin-sailor.md), Twin Sailors** — A letter from [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) details his imaginary, whimsical companions near the shore, including [Nora](../character/nora.md), the [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md), and the [Twin Sailors](../codex/places.md#twin-sailors). He describes fantastic adventures with them, such as sailing into the moon and traveling into the sunset.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P44](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0044)_

## XII A Jonah Day

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Anthony Tulk](../character/anthony-tulk.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), [Chester Mott](../character/chester-mott.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Ned Clay](../character/ned-clay.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), [Prillie Rogerson](../character/prillie-rogerson.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — Suffering from a toothache, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) loses her temper at school, accidentally causing firecrackers to detonate in the stove and later whipping [Anthony Tulk](../character/anthony-tulk.md) for putting a mouse in her desk. Devastated by her loss of composure, she confides in [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) at home. The next morning, Anthony surprisingly shows respect for her actions, which is later confirmed by [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md).

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P36](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0036)_

## XIII A Golden Picnic

**[Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Isolde, [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), and [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) spend a spring Saturday exploring the woods and fields together. Along their path, they encounter a quiet pool they name [Crystal Lake](../codex/places.md#crystal-lake) and discover an abandoned, flower-filled garden. Sitting among the narcissi, Isolde tells the story of [Dinah](../character/dinah-wren.md) and [Jordan](../character/jordan.md) Wren, the couple who originally created the hidden garden.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P6](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0006), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P29](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0029), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P44](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0044), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051)_

**[Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md), and Isolde finish talking about [Dinah Wren](../character/dinah-wren.md) before spending the rest of the afternoon exploring the woods and eating lunch by a brook. They discuss nature, poetry, and what souls might look like before gathering narcissus blossoms and walking home at sunset.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P56](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0056), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P61](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0061), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P68](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0068), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P73](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0073)_

## XIV A Danger Averted

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Carrie Mott](../character/carrie-mott.md), [Gideon Duckett](../character/gideon-duckett.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Tibby Tulk](../character/tibby-tulk.md)** — Mrs. Sowerby chats with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about church bazaar plans before [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) goes home to discuss family letters with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and handle Robin's comedic mischief. Later, at a B.V.I.S. meeting, [Tibby Tulk](../character/tibby-tulk.md) reveals that [Judson Tibbs](../character/judson-tibbs.md) plans to rent his farm fence for commercial ads, sparking panic among the members.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P0](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0000), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P12](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0012), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P18](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0018), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035)_

**[Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Judson Tibbs](../character/judson-tibbs.md), [Gideon Duckett](../character/gideon-duckett.md), [Carrie Mott](../character/carrie-mott.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Oliver Mott](../character/oliver-mott.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Tobias Corcoran](../character/tobias-corcoran.md)** — The Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) worries about [Judson Tibbs](../character/judson-tibbs.md) leasing his fences for medicine advertisements. A delegation consisting of [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Isolde, and [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) meets with Judson, but he refuses to change his mind. Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accidentally overhears Judson accepting a political bribe from [Tobias Corcoran](../character/tobias-corcoran.md), prompting Judson to drop the advertising plan to keep her silent.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P49](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0049), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P61](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0061), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P66](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0066)_

## XV The Beginning of Vacation

**[Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Wace](../character/wace.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walks to the cemetery with her young pupil [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), who talks about his late mother, his father, and his life with his grandmother. At the graveyard, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) places flowers on the graves of [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) and [Dinah](../character/dinah-wren.md), then walks home with Mrs. [Wace](../character/wace.md), discussing her teaching, ideals, friendship, and future prospects.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P2](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0002), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P24](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0024), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P26](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0026)_

**[Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), [Wace](../character/wace.md), [Tibby Tulk](../character/tibby-tulk.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Mrs. [Wace](../character/wace.md) discuss Nell's education, future prospects, and gratitude for her life and friends. They talk about the true nature of friendship, contrasting deep loyalty with shallow connections like that of [Tibby Tulk](../character/tibby-tulk.md) and Julia.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P43](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0043), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P44](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0044), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P46](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0046), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P47](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0047)_

## XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For

**[John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md), [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — In the [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) kitchen, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) shares his funny childhood misunderstanding about heaven before [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) reveals exciting news from a letter: the famous author Mrs. [Varley](../character/varley.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) are coming to visit. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) enthusiastically plans and prepares a elaborate dinner menu for the upcoming visit, while [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) assist with the preparations.

_Sources: [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P0](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0000), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P11](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0011), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P14](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0014), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P20](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0020)_

## XVII A Chapter of Accidents

**[Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Thorne](../character/thorne.md), [Wace](../character/wace.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde spend the morning busily preparing [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and cooking a lavish meal to welcome Mrs. [Varley](../character/varley.md), but [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) accidentally ruins the lemon pies and gets sent to his room. When Mrs. [Varley](../character/varley.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) fail to arrive, the group sits down to eat without them, only to discover the peas have been over-sweetened by multiple cooks. To make matters worse, as dinner ends, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) accidentally knocks a heavy shell down the stairs, shattering Miss Pembroke's borrowed platter.

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P27](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0027), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P42](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0042), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P52](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0052), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P57](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0057)_

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Eliza Pullen](../character/eliza-pullen.md), [Gorham Pullen](../character/gorham-pullen.md), [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Isabella Pullen](../character/isabella-pullen.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), [Miss Pembroke](../character/miss-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Varley](../character/varley.md), [Wace](../character/wace.md)** — During lunch, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) accidentally knocks down and smashes Miss Pembroke's platter, leaving [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) deeply apologetic. After the guests leave, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives a letter from [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) stating their visit is canceled. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) sit together outdoors, discussing the day's mishaps, life's disappointments, and local rumors as Hugh approaches.

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P57](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0057), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P60](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0060), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P79](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0079)_

## XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

**[Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde drive out to the Copp property in [Tullyvale](../codex/places.md#tullyvale) searching for a willow-ware platter. While trying to look into the pantry window, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) breaks through the roof of an old duck house and becomes stuck. Isolde stays with her through a sudden rainstorm until [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp returns.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P19](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0019), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P34](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0034), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P48](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0048), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P54](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0054)_

**[Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md), [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md)** — While waiting in the duckhouse, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) writes down a garden conversation with Isolde's assistance. Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp frees [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) with a hatchet, feeds the girls, and agrees to sell them her willow-ware platter for twenty-five dollars, revealing she plans to get married. The girls then drive away with the platter along [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road).

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P51](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0051), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P62](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0062), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P64](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0064)_

## XIX Just a Happy Day

**[Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md), [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) visits [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) at his house, where they discuss his thoughts, his late mother, and his worries about his maid's comments before sharing tea together. Afterwards, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home to comfort a jealous [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md) and listen to his evening prayers.

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P2](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0002), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P23](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0023), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P34](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0034), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P44](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0044)_

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) puts [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) to bed after helping him settle his worries about her feelings compared to [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md). Later, she meets [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) near the Nymph's Well, where they talk about community improvements and mutual friends before [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home to plan her tasks with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md).

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P34](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0034), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P55](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0055), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P61](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0061)_

## XX The Way It Often Happens

**[Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Varley](../character/varley.md), [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md)** — [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) depart for town, leaving [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) at home. While transferring feathers, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accidentally applies rug dye to her nose, but Isolde helps her wash it off before they host [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), Mrs. [Varley](../character/varley.md), and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) for dinner and a stroll.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P1](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0001), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P36](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0036), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P43](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0043)_

## XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind

**[Belinda](../character/belinda.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), [Milty Gammon](../character/milty-gammon.md), [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to teaching school, where [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) reports his classroom antics while [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) is terrified by [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) Cotton's stories of family ghosts. Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde take a wrong turn while walking through the autumn woods to a tea invitation and discover [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage), where its owner, Miss Rosalind [Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), invites them to stay for tea.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P16](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0016), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)_

**[Belinda](../character/belinda.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md)** — Miss Rosalind welcomes Isolde and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) for tea at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) and explains her solitary life, imaginative habits, and why her young helper is called Belinda the Fourth. When [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) Stanhope's name is mentioned, Miss Rosalind asks if he is [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) Stanhope's son before growing quiet and distant. As the girls walk away, they reflect on her loneliness and the meaning of names.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P84](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0084)_

## XXII Odds and Ends

**[Lucy](../character/lucy.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — During breakfast at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) discuss [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) Penrose's appearance and past engagement, while dealing with Robin's table manners. A month later, a letter arrives revealing that [Richard Farrow](../character/richard-farrow.md) has passed away, leaving a trust fund for the twins so they can remain permanently at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters).

_Sources: [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P0](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0000), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P25](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0025)_

## XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance

**[Stanhope](../character/stanhope.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walks to [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) to spend a cozy winter night with Miss Rosalind, who shares the story of her long-ago engagement to [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) and the prideful misunderstanding that separated them. A month later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) brings Stephen's son, [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), to meet Miss Rosalind, and the two quickly bond during a pleasant visit.

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P16](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0016), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027)_

## XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

**[Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Gorham Pullen](../character/gorham-pullen.md), [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md), [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md), [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) dismisses school early as a monstrous storm approaches, exactly as [Uncle Zeb](../character/uncle-zeb.md) predicted. She rushes home with [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), where they shelter with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) through a terrifying 45-minute hail storm that devastates crops and shatters windows. Afterward, [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md) arrives to report that lightning struck Mr. Pettifer's home and killed his pet parrot, [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md), prompting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to visit and offer comfort.

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P18](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0018), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P41](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0041)_

**[Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Levi Gammon](../character/levi-gammon.md), [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md), [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Uncle Zeb](../character/uncle-zeb.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) comforts Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) after the storm kills his parrot, [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md). The community assesses the widespread destruction, while [Uncle Zeb](../character/uncle-zeb.md) revels in the exactness of his storm prediction. Hugh visits [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to recount the panic at the school and discuss the damage with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P48](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0048), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P49](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0049), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P54](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0054)_

## XXV An Brierley Scandal

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Emily](../character/emily.md), [James A](../character/james-a.md), [Ned Clay](../character/ned-clay.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — A stylish older woman arrives at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) looking for [James A](../character/james-a.md). [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) and reveals to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that she is his long-estranged wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md). The news quickly spreads through the village, and when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) visits Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), she finds his house freshly cleaned and learns that he is secretly glad to have his wife back.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P9](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0009), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P29](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0029), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P46](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0046)_

**[Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Emily](../character/emily.md), [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md), [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Eliza Pullen](../character/eliza-pullen.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Milty Gammon](../character/milty-gammon.md)** — Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) explains to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) the history of his marriage, his quarrel over his parrot [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md), and his eventual reconciliation with [Emily](../character/emily.md). Later, Mrs. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) expresses her gratitude over the paper's note, and Mrs. Sowerby chats with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) before [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) puts a sleepy [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) to bed.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P65](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0065), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P70](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0070)_

## XXVI Around the Bend

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md), [Anthony Tulk](../character/anthony-tulk.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), [Eliza Pullen](../character/eliza-pullen.md), [Grandma Stanhope](../character/grandma-stanhope.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), [Milty Gammon](../character/milty-gammon.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Thomas Sowerby](../character/thomas-sowerby.md)** — Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-sowerby.md) Sowerby's death, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) proposes inviting the widowed [Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) to move into [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) so that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) can attend [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) resigns from her teaching position, causing her students great dismay, while she and Isolde discuss the upcoming changes in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley).

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P37](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0037)_

**[Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md), [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde talk in bed at night about local gossip, the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), and Nell's upcoming departure for [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college). They discuss romance, Nell's feelings about Hugh, and Opal Pettigrew's behavior, concluding with a heartfelt reaffirmation of their deep and lasting friendship.

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P41](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0041), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P45](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0045), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P58](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0058), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P60](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0060)_

## XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

**[Belinda](../character/belinda.md), [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), [Eliza Pullen](../character/eliza-pullen.md), [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), [Milty Gammon](../character/milty-gammon.md), [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md), [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), [Prillie Rogerson](../character/prillie-rogerson.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) chats with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) during a meal, sharing stories about [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) and [Milty Gammon](../character/milty-gammon.md). Afterwards, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) walk to [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) to visit [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) and [Belinda](../character/belinda.md), where they share food, enjoy the echoes, and go off to pick early strawberries.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P37](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0037)_

**[Belinda](../character/belinda.md), [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md), [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md)** — While picking strawberries for tea, [Belinda](../character/belinda.md) expresses concern to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) over Miss Rosalind's lingering melancholic mood and failing health. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) resolves to stay at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) during her vacation to help lift Miss Rosalind's spirits. Afterwards, the group enjoys tea outside, and [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) sits with Miss Rosalind as she opens up to him about her imaginary dream-boy.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P49](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0049), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P51](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0051)_

## XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

**[Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), [Gorham Pullen](../character/gorham-pullen.md), [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Peter Mott](../character/peter-mott.md), [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md), [William Bell](../character/william-bell.md)** — Following the end of the school term, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) visits [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) and meets his father, [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md), who has unexpectedly arrived. [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) asks [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to inquire if he may visit [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), prompting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to deliver the request to a pale [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) and post the letter.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P20](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0020), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P39](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0039)_

**[Belinda](../character/belinda.md), [Stanhope](../character/stanhope.md), [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md), [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) writes a letter to [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) and sends it via the post office. Later that evening, [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) arrives at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) to see [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md). To the delight of [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Belinda](../character/belinda.md), [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) and [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) walk into the garden together, embracing as lovers.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P45](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0045), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P71](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0071)_

## XXIX Poetry and Prose

**[Belinda](../character/belinda.md), [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), [Gideon Duckett](../character/gideon-duckett.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) prepares for Rosalind's wedding while discussing the romantic developments with [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md). Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) stumbles upon Isolde and [Gideon](../character/gideon-duckett.md) sharing an intimate moment in the garden, confirming their secret love. Isolde then visits [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to confide her engagement, leaving [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to reflect on love and her own romantic ideals.

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P1](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0001), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P15](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0015)_

## XXX A Wedding at the Stone House

**[Belinda](../character/belinda.md), [Stanhope](../character/stanhope.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md), [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md), [Wace](../character/wace.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and her friends assist with the preparations for [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) Penrose's wedding at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage). The ceremony takes place in the garden as the sun breaks through the overcast sky, after which the guests see the newlyweds off at the train station. Left alone after tidying up, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) waits for Hugh and experiences a subtle shift in her feelings toward him.

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P40](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0040)_

**[Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), [Stanhope](../character/stanhope.md)** — As Hugh walks with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to his buggy, they reflect on [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) and Stanhope's reunion. Hugh's gentle words trigger a sudden awakening in [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), shifting her perspective from girlhood to womanhood as she recognizes deeper feelings within their companionship.

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P37](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0037), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P39](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0039), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P40](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0040), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P41](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0041)_
